learner_operation: Identify the surrounding temperature as equilibrium, represent the temperature excess T-T_S, and choose a negative rate proportional to that excess with k>0; distinguish sign, equilibrium and spurious factors. Moderate cases also require ignoring the initial object temperature.

fixed_features.feature: Negative proportionality with k>0, approaching a fixed ambient temperature from above
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial f58653bc-cafb-532a-b92d-8183054c181b states dT/dt=-k(T-T_S); introduction requires T>ambient.

fixed_features.feature: Five equations, one radio answer, generic then substituted solution
fixed_features.justification: All ten captured source question banks use this response contract and two-stage solution.

fixed_features.feature: Easy has one ambient reading; moderate also gives initial object reading
fixed_features.justification: Source 246dbe47-9137-5b96-af87-04ddded3bed6 versus 58a15628-6a07-582f-a2d4-e1c7a7c6e77c establishes this workload distinction.

fixed_features.feature: Correct option always uses canonical -k(T-S) representation
fixed_features.justification: This is the intended Newton model and is acceptable mathematical recognition. Fixing its position or superficial length advantage is not required.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Ambient values in source-supported C and F easy/moderate contexts
answer_roles.observed: Ambient values vary; all easy generator profiles use Celsius. The captured easy Fahrenheit cake case q-106877 is omitted.
Shuffled and varied within templates. No demonstrated position shortcut.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Initial stays above ambient; varying initial alone must preserve correct model
answer_roles.observed: Relevant ambient changes alter answer; irrelevant initial changes preserve model. Turkey/soup force three-digit initial and two-digit ambient, making correct choice always uniquely shortest.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Preserve source banks in replay; use justified same-method bank variants in practice so superficial signatures do not uniquely identify the answer
answer_roles.observed: Source-style templates fix a length advantage in turkey/soup, with a conditional recurrence for thermometer I>=100.

coverage.result: Nine of ten banks replay completely; q-106877 raises Profile outside difficulty.
90 records, ten per supported template, including ambient boundaries. Mathematical keys and solutions pass; turkey/soup shortest strategy 20/20.

5/5 survive, five distinct Celsius ambients, templates liquid/chocolate/body. First-position cue 2/5; unique-shortest cue 0/5; no demonstrated batch-wide shortcut from these probes. Missing Fahrenheit generator family remains a package defect, not a separate claim that this five-item batch must contain every family.

All seven generated inventory records independently reproduced with matching stored identities and saved generation provenance. None exhibits the demonstrated unique-shortest cue; original source examples are not classified as generated.

counterfactuals.justification: Source solutions substitute ambient only; initial is irrelevant to setting up the ODE in moderate cases.

delivery.result: Exact batch 5 -> 5; independent easy 40 -> 38, moderate 50 -> 48. All 20 turkey/soup cases survive their moderate delivery stage. The requested easy stage excludes moderate cases as intended. Within a positive difficulty band, the selection algorithm leaves the surviving family shortcut reachable; it cannot repair the missing easy generator family. No preparation file or live publication was available; actual shared read-only filtering used captured basis 5389.

limitations: Finite audit does not prove absence of every shortcut.
